gloss: award history; record of awards won

definitions.gloss: award history; record of prizes won
definitions.explanation: A record or list of the prizes and awards a person or work has received over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧な{受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He has a brilliant award history.

examples.japanese: {受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To list one's award history on a résumé.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: This director has an extensive record of awards at international film festivals.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧ (winning a prize) + {歴|れき} (record, history). The suffix {歴|れき} marks a track record, as in ⟦{職歴|しょくれき}→職歴：17959_shokureki⟧ (work history) or ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧ (educational background).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a record of awards
- ⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧な{受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}: a glittering award history
- {受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧: to boast an impressive award record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧: winning a prize — a single act, not the cumulative record
- ⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧: track record, achievements — broader than awards alone
